lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 to 14 distinct vertical white lines on the juvenile's lateral torso. Spacing is relatively even in the mid-torso and becomes progressively closer and more fragmented in the posterior section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The majority of the posterior lines (lines 6 through 14) are discontinuous, transitioning from solid segments at the dorsal ridge to discrete dashes or spots along the lower torso and haunch.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8-10 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch and upper hind limb area, distinct from the main torso stripes.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three spots on the posterior haunch align in a semi-vertical geometric line, effectively extending the visual trajectory of the 12th torso line.

other_distinctive_markers: Two distinct white facial spots are located on the cheek area below the eye; a large, high-contrast white patch is visible on the lower ventral neck/chest region.
